how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:mage-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:8250:obj:0: Seek out Sanath Lim-yo and gain passage to see Archmage Xylem.
rows.quest:8250:details:0: Archmage Xylem has been asking around lately... for someone of your experience.
rows.quest:8250:details:1: BIf you wish to seek him out, you can find him in ⟦E1⟧. His tower is built high atop the cliffs, and the only way up is a teleport spell invoked by his arrogant servant, Sanath Lim-yo.
rows.quest:8250:details:2: BSanath makes camp below his master's tower. To find him, travel to where ⟦E1⟧'s main road forks at the entrance to the Ruins of Eldarath. From that spot, head directly north until you reach the cliffs.
rows.quest:8251:obj:0: Bring 10 Glittering Dust to Archmage Xylem.
rows.quest:8251:details:0: The blood elves in ⟦E1⟧ have developed a method for pulverizing the magical items they acquire. This glittering dust they produce differs from the components normally acquired by a disenchantment spell.
rows.quest:8251:details:1: BWhen I sent my apprentice to trade for the dust, he was killed without hesitation. For that, they must pay.
rows.quest:8251:details:2: BThe time for talk is over, ⟦2⟧. Find the blood elves along the cliffs of ⟦E1⟧ and use more "persuasive" methods to acquire their glittering dust.
rows.quest:8251:completion:0: Well done, ⟦3⟧! It never ceases to amaze me how persuasive a ⟦E2⟧ of arcane missiles can be.
rows.quest:8252:obj:0: Collect 6 Enchanted Coral and return them to Archmage Xylem.
rows.quest:8252:details:0: Take a look around you. The ruins and beaches are overrun with spitelash. Recently, the wretched creatures have learned to recognize the rare components indigenous to ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8252:details:1: BSpecifically, I speak of enchanted coral -- they are drawn to it by reasons unknown to me. Now there is little coral left in the bay, and it is vital to my research. I need you to separate some enchanted coral from the spitelash sirens and bring it to me.
rows.quest:8252:completion:0: This is a superb specimen of coral, ⟦4⟧. Your skills are unquestionably precise and deadly.
rows.quest:8252:completion:1: BDo not think your efforts have gone unnoticed. Perhaps you are worthy of a true test of your skill...
rows.quest:8253:obj:0: Retrieve the ⟦E3⟧ Shard from Morphaz and return to Archmage Xylem.
rows.quest:8253:details:0: There is a green drake deep in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar by the name of Morphaz.
rows.quest:8253:details:1: BYears ago, he overwhelmed me in a bold ambush and consumed my apprentice whole. While the loss of an apprentice is not unknown to me, this particular one carried an arcane shard of unsurpassed size and quality.
rows.quest:8253:details:2: BYou must gather powerful allies and delve into the temple. Destroy Morphaz and recover the arcane shard from his ageless stomach.
rows.quest:8253:completion:0: Incredible. The shard has grown as it absorbed the drake's energy over the long years.
rows.quest:8253:completion:1: BThere is no more I can ask of you now. My full ability to forge the arcane has returned with this shard. My first creation is yours, ⟦5⟧, and you have but to choose...
rows.quest:9362:obj:0: Retrieve the Prismatic Shell for Archmage Xylem. The Archmage resides in a tower atop the cliffs of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:9362:details:0: There isn't much time, ⟦6⟧! My scrying spells have revealed a powerful source of magic. I cannot leave the tower, and would ask you to kill the vile creature in possession of this artifact.
rows.quest:9362:details:1: BThe pathetic little cretin is known as Warlord Krellian, hiding behind his guards in the Temple of Zin-Malor. ⟦E4⟧ him to ashes and take the prismatic shell he covets so dearly.
rows.quest:9362:completion:0: I must say, this shell has a strange aura. It seems only fitting that part of your reward for retrieving it would be to test its magical capabilities...
rows.quest:9364:obj:0: Polymorph the Spitelash of ⟦E1⟧ and kill the clones that appear several seconds later. When you have slain 50 Polymorph Clones, return to Archmage Xylem in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:9364:details:0: My research has revealed a unique purpose for the prismatic shell.
rows.quest:9364:details:1: BCarry the shell and cast your polymorph spell on the Spitelash in ⟦E1⟧. If you wait a few moments, the chaotic aura of the shell will cause them to split into several smaller clones for a few moments. Kill these clones as quickly as possible, and the shell will collect their essence.
rows.quest:9364:details:2: BWhen the shell is full, return it to me.
rows.quest:9364:completion:1: BNow we are able to reform this magic into a new spell. Behold!
